Review 

3 years of data of oat yield in a split-plot design.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)

oat1 <- read.csv("../code/20_repeat_splitplot.y1.csv")

oat2 <- read.csv("../data/20_repeat_splitplot.y2.csv")

oat3 <- read.csv("../data/20_repeat_splitplot.y3.csv")

# infiles = list.files(path="data", pattern = "20_repeat", full.names = TRUE)
#lapply(infiles,read.csv)
# Combine into a single dataframe using # dplyr::bind_rows(aots1,oats2,oats3)

bind_rows(oat1,oat2,oat3)


```

```{r}

mymodel = lmer(yield ~ variety * spacing + (1|subplot) + (1|wholeplot) + (1|year), data = rep_splitplot) 

# Subplot, wholeplot, and year must be random effects because they induce correlation into our data.

summary(mymodel)

```

```{r}

maedow <- read.csv("../data/20_meadowfoam.csv")
maedow

```

```{r}
model_maedow <- lmer(TSW ~ (1|Entry) + (1|Block), data = maedow)
ranova(model_maedow)

```
